name: Kimitsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Kimitsu city emblem in white: a ring open at the top with two pointed ears, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Kimitsu, a city in Chiba Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 28 October 1963.

features.role: Kimitsu city emblem — a ring open at the top with two pointed ears, enclosing a stylised character
